Freego X0 Electric Mini Bike for Teens and Adults

The Freego X0 is a electric mini bike for teens and adults built around the current specification data in Shopify. Key details include 2000 W (Nominal), 3600 W (Peak); Rear Brushless DC Hub Motor, 60V, 23Ah (1380Wh) lithium battery with 80×21700 cells, and City Mode: 20 MPH (32 km/h) ; Off-Raod Mode: 40 MPH (64 km/h).

Riding range: City Mode (15 mph): up to 50 miles; Off-Road Mode (25 mph): up to 20 miles. Tested with rider weight 165 lbs, no cargo, flat road, 77 °F, no wind

Why Riders Choose the Freego X0

The Freego X0 is designed for riders who want clear power delivery, practical controls, and a chassis matched to off-road and adventure use. Its specification set lists High-strength Steel Pipe, Hydraulic Front & Rear Shock Absorbers, and Front 14” (with spokes) × Rear 10”, Tubed Pneumatic Motorcycle-Grade, Puncture-Resistant.

Key Specifications

Motor Power 2000 W (Nominal), 3600 W (Peak)
Rear Brushless DC Hub Motor

Battery 60V, 23Ah (1380Wh) lithium battery with 80×21700 cells

Riding Range City Mode (15 mph): up to 50 miles; Off-Road Mode (25 mph): up to 20 miles. Tested with rider weight 165 lbs, no cargo, flat road, 77 °F, no wind

Motor Activation Electric throttle only, no pedal-assist sensor

Controller Brushless Motor Controller, 45 A nominal / 180 A peak

Throttle Type Full-twist Throttle

Frame High-strength Steel Pipe

Display LCD Display

Max Load 220 lb (100 kg)

Charging Time 3-6 H

Charger Specification 67.2V, 3A

Net Weight 99 lb (45 kg) including battery (battery weight: 13 lb / 6 kg)

Brake System Hydraulic Disc Brakes, 2-piston, 203 mm rotors, front & rear

Wheel Size & Tires Front 14” (with spokes) × Rear 10”, Tubed Pneumatic Motorcycle-Grade, Puncture-Resistant

Suspension Hydraulic Front & Rear Shock Absorbers

Tubes Inflatable thick inner tubes

Lighting LED headlight, rear brake light, and turn signals

Package Size 59” × 11.8” × 32.7” (150 × 30 × 83 cm)

Suggested Rider Height 4’7”–5’9” (140–175 cm)

Range Note

Riding range is based on the listed test conditions in the specification. Actual range can vary with rider weight, speed, terrain, temperature, wind, tire pressure, payload, and riding mode.
